Name: Kuromi Backpack (EN ES ZH)
Author: POCHIMODS
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54585/54585-1792943376-2097597377.png[/img]

[b][color=#d4b3ec]ESPAÑOL[/color][/b]
Una bonita mochila inspirada en Kuromi, en negro y gris, con su característica calavera rosa y tirantes a juego para acompañarte por Stardew Valley.

[b]✦ ─────── Capacidad y precios ─────── ✦[/b]
Puedes comprar Kuromi en la tienda de Pierre o de Sandy por [b]500 g[/b]. Después, pulsa [b]F7[/b] para abrir [b]Mis mochilas[/b] y seleccionarla.
Las ampliaciones opcionales aumentan tu inventario normal a [b]24 espacios por 2.000 g[/b] y a [b]36 espacios por 10.000 g[/b]. Si ya tienes esas ampliaciones, conservarás tus espacios al cambiar de diseño.

[b]✦ ─────── Instalación ─────── ✦[/b]
1. Instala [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b] y [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54342]Backpack Wardrobe[/url][/b]; ambos son necesarios.
2. Descarga el archivo ZIP de [b]Kuromi Backpack[/b] y descomprímelo.
3. Copia la carpeta [b]KuromiBackpack[/b] dentro de la carpeta [b]Mods[/b] de Stardew Valley.
4. Comprueba la estructura: [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/KuromiBackpack/manifest.json[/b]. Evita que haya otra carpeta KuromiBackpack adicional entre medias.
5. Inicia el juego mediante [b]SMAPI[/b]. Compra la mochila y pulsa [b]F7[/b] (o la tecla que hayas configurado en Mis mochilas) para elegirla.

[b]Idiomas:[/b] inglés, español y chino simplificado. El idioma se adapta al que tengas seleccionado en el juego.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54585/54585-1792943457-935940335.png[/img]

[b][color=#d4b3ec]ENGLISH[/color][/b]
A cute Kuromi-inspired backpack in black and grey, featuring her signature pink skull and matching straps to accompany you through Stardew Valley.

[b]✦ ─────── Capacity and prices ─────── ✦[/b]
You can buy Kuromi at Pierre's or Sandy's shop for [b]500g[/b]. Then press [b]F7[/b] to open [b]My Backpacks[/b] and select it.
Optional upgrades expand your normal inventory to [b]24 slots for 2,000g[/b] and [b]36 slots for 10,000g[/b]. If you already have these upgrades, you will keep your slots when switching designs.

[b]✦ ─────── Installation ─────── ✦[/b]
1. Install [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54342]Backpack Wardrobe[/url][/b]; both are required.
2. Download the [b]Kuromi Backpack[/b] ZIP file and extract it.
3. Copy the [b]KuromiBackpack[/b] folder into Stardew Valley's [b]Mods[/b] folder.
4. Check the folder structure: [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/KuromiBackpack/manifest.json[/b]. Make sure there is no extra KuromiBackpack folder nested in between.
5. Launch the game through [b]SMAPI[/b]. Buy the backpack and press [b]F7[/b] (or the key you configured in My Backpacks) to select it.

[b]Languages:[/b] English, Spanish and Simplified Chinese. The mod automatically uses the language selected in your game.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54585/54585-1792943457-935940335.png[/img]

[b][color=#d4b3ec]简体中文[/color][/b]
一款可爱的库洛米主题背包，采用黑灰配色，搭配标志性的粉色骷髅和同色肩带，陪伴你探索星露谷。

[b]✦ ─────── 容量与价格 ─────── ✦[/b]
你可以在皮埃尔或桑迪的商店花费[b]500金[/b]购买库洛米背包。购买后，按[b]F7[/b]打开[b]“我的背包”[/b]菜单并选择它。
可选扩容可将普通物品栏增加至[b]24格，价格为2000金[/b]，或[b]36格，价格为10000金[/b]。如果你已经购买了这些扩容，切换背包外观时会保留现有容量。

[b]✦ ─────── 安装方法 ─────── ✦[/b]
1. 安装[b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b]和[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54342]Backpack Wardrobe[/url][/b]，两者均为必需。
2. 下载[b]Kuromi Backpack[/b]的ZIP文件并解压。
3. 将[b]KuromiBackpack[/b]文件夹复制到星露谷游戏目录中的[b]Mods[/b]文件夹。
4. 确认目录结构为：[b]Stardew Valley/Mods/KuromiBackpack/manifest.json[/b]。请勿在中间额外嵌套一层KuromiBackpack文件夹。
5. 通过[b]SMAPI[/b]启动游戏。购买背包后，按[b]F7[/b]（或你在“我的背包”中设置的按键）选择它。

[b]语言：[/b]英语、西班牙语和简体中文。模组会自动使用游戏中选择的语言。
[/center]
